look: Shot on ARRI Alexa 65 with anamorphic lenses, premium cinematic commercial, teal-and-amber grade, deep rich blacks, volumetric light, subtle film grain, ultra detailed, vertical 9:16 composition, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
tomas: S01_imprenta

Extreme close-up inside an industrial money printing press at night: sheets of generic fictional banknotes (abstract guilloche patterns, no readable text, no faces, no numbers) racing through steel rollers, harsh red warning light and cold blue rim light, metallic sheen, sense of unstoppable speed.
S02_lluvia

Thousands of generic fictional banknotes (no text, no faces) falling in slow motion through a pitch-black void, backlit by a single hard top light, a few edges glowing as if burning, dust in the light beam, dramatic and ominous.
S03_manos

Close-up of the tired hands of a Latin American woman factory worker at dusk counting a few worn generic banknotes on a wooden table under a single bare bulb, her face partly in shadow, serious, nobody smiling, intimate and heavy mood.
S04_andes
Epic aerial drone shot over the Andes mountains at sunrise: snowy peaks, golden light raking across vast terraced copper mine benches and a winding road, low clouds in the valleys, monumental scale.
S05_amazonas
Epic aerial shot of a huge winding Amazon river through endless rainforest at golden hour, mist rising from the jungle canopy, flocks of birds, majestic.
S06_ciudad

Aerial night shot over a vast Latin American megacity (like São Paulo or Mexico City), skyscrapers and avenues with flowing light trails, warm sodium lights and cool blue towers, low haze, cinematic grandeur.
S08_luz

In a dark minimalist architectural atrium with black glass floor, a floating sphere made of millions of glowing blue-white particles is forming in mid-air, reflected on the glass floor, anamorphic blue lens flare, haze, awe-inspiring, futuristic but elegant.
S09_mujer

A young Latin American woman at night by a big window of her apartment overlooking city lights, softly talking to her phone held in her hand, a gentle blue-white glow from the screen illuminating her face, calm and intimate, she looks at the phone, not at camera.
S10_huella
Extreme macro of a thumb touching the glass of a smartphone screen in the dark, a ring of soft blue light expanding from the fingerprint, shallow depth of field, premium product shot.
S11_anillo
In total darkness, a stream of molten warm-white light flowing and curving to form a perfect glowing ring, liquid metal light, slow and elegant, sparks drifting, premium luxury feel.
S12_patagonia
Aerial shot over Patagonia at blue hour: jagged granite peaks, a turquoise glacier lake, a tiny lone road, clouds racing, vast and pristine.
S13_mina

A Latin American mining engineer woman in a white hard hat stands at the edge of a vast open-pit mine in the Andes at dawn, a glowing holographic 3D terrain map floating above her rugged tablet, warm sunrise light, epic, dignified, not looking at camera.
S14_cafe

A Colombian coffee cooperative warehouse at golden hour: workers carrying jute sacks of coffee, sunbeams through the doors, dust in the light, a woman leader inspecting beans, dignified, nobody smiling at camera.
S15_fabrica
A modern Latin American factory: orange robotic arms welding with bright sparks, a woman engineer with a clear visor supervising, steel and blue light, powerful, high-tech industry.
